scope: Descriptive analysis of all 32 fresh-process C1 measurements; not a claim of preregistration or independent-geometry validation.
crossing: First successful observed accepted state, with prior-failure/current-success brackets for solver and elapsed state clocks; separately report time when evaluation is available.
stability: First sequence of three successful observations: start and confirmation times, plus terminal status and pass-to-fail transition count over all observed states.
unreached: Keep in the denominator. Conditional successful-run time summaries are explicitly labelled. Never replace NR by an invented crossing.
common_horizon: For a supplementary all-seed cost summary, tau is the minimum final observed solver-state time across the complete cohort. Use min(first observed hit, tau), with NR assigned tau solely for this restricted descriptive summary. Also report attained counts within tau; not a claim that NR actually reached at tau.
paired_comparisons: Seed-paired geometric mean time ratios and 95% percentile bootstrap intervals only when both methods reach the target in all eight seeds; otherwise show rates and restricted-horizon summaries. Resample eight paired seeds 10000 times with RNG 20261222. No p-value claims.
resources: Per-method mean, SD and range of solver CUDA allocated/reserved peaks, process lifetime RAM, and process CPU time. Resource capacity, parameter count and actual consumption remain distinct.
clock_conventions: Time-to-target refers to the computed parameter state before a disk export. Terminal full-solver cost includes final solution export. Evaluation and extra logging are separately measured; external monitoring overhead is not subtracted.
numerical_audit: Check frozen input and code hashes, sampling and initial-state equality, monotone clocks, sum of solver and common-diagnostic time, all 32 result/telemetry records, and current-run metric consistency. Historical endpoint accuracy is not reused.
interference: Use frozen measurement protocol flags, preserve every attempt. Do not pool flagged measurements into an unqualified fair-time result.
limitations: Eight development seeds; seed variation is not repeated-timing jitter at identical weights
No direct claim for new coupled physical-neural candidates
No energy-consumption claim from runtime alone
